It can retweet and favor it to its.
It can follow users who tweet on particular topics.
It can send DMs or direct messages to your new followers.
It can reply to tweets with a public reply or even a DM.
And finally, it can add users who tweet on particular topics to one of your Twitter lists.
The other interesting feature of the Tritterbots application is that you can specify the time
period for which the bots should run.
So for instance, if you're offline during evening or late night, you can instruct the
bot to only run between 6 pm to 9 pm when you are usually offline.
Okay, now that you know what the bots can do, it's time to create a Tritterbot.
So the first thing you need to do is go to apps.tritter.com and create a new Tritter application.
Now this is the easy part.
All you have to do is fill in the Tritterbots name, a unique description and your website
address.
Now remember to put the full website address including the HTTP part.
Finally, agree to the developer terms and conditions and create your application.

So we are all set, it is now time to create the bots.
So writing a bot is simple.
You specify the search term, you specify the action and the bot is ready.
So for the first bot, let's say we are trying to capture all tweets that mention the hashtag
green energy and that have been retweeted at least 10 number of times.

For the second bot, let's have some fun.

is this.

of the bot.
For the next bot, I'm trying to find out interesting users who tweet about life hacks and I'm trying

when this Twitter list should already exist and second, the way you should specify the

youtube_description:
Create Twitter bots at digitalinspiration.com/bots

Learn how to create your own twitter bots that can:

1. Auto Reply to Tweets
2. Retweet Tweets
3. Follow Users
4. Add Users to Twitter List
5. Search users by profile
6. DM New Followers
7. Set out-of-office auto reply tweets

No programming required.

Tutorial https://www.labnol.org/internet/write-twitter-bot/27902/

Twitter: http://twitter.com/labnol
Facebook: http://facebook.com/digital.inspiration
